[[Fort Washington, Maryland]] | former_school(s)=[[Indiana University (Bloomington)|Indiana]] (2003–05) | awards = }} '''Patrick Ewing, Jr.''' (born [[May 20]], [[1985]] in [[Boston, Massachusetts]], [[United States|U.S.]]) is an American [[college basketball|collegiate basketball]] player. He is the son of retired [[NBA]] great [[Patrick Ewing]] and Sharon Campbell. He has three brothers and three sisters. He is a 6-foot-8, 224-pound forward. He first attended Windward High School in [[White Plains, New York]] before going to Holy Innocents' Episcopal School, [[Marietta High School (Georgia)|Marietta High School]] in [[Georgia (U.S. state)|Georgia]], and National Christian Academy in [[Maryland]]. He signed with [[Indiana University (Bloomington)|Indiana University]] on [[May 1]], [[2003]]. Following in his father's footsteps, he transferred in [[2005]] to [[Georgetown University]] in [[Washington, D.C.]] Under the [[National Collegiate Athletic Association|NCAA]] transfer rules, Patrick Ewing, Jr., affectionately known as "Trixie" to his teammates, had to sit out the 2005-06 season. Ewing wears jersey number 33, like his father. [[Alonzo Mourning]] was last to use this number for Georgetown, and he reportedly had to get Mourning's permission before using it {{cite web|title=JTIII Talks to D.C. Sports Bog|url=http://blog.washingtonpost.com/dcsportsbog/2006/10/jtiii_talks_to_us.html}}. In the 2007-08 season, he participated in the College [[Slam Dunk Contest]] at [[St.Mary's University]] in [[San Antonio]], Tx during [[Final Four]] weekend.
